description: Institutions inside the supervisory perimeter. The submitter of an authorisation dossier is always one of these — an agent operator is not a regulated entity anywhere, so the obligation attaches here. See docs/synthetic-data-spec.md Part 0.2.

institutions.notes: Processes card-not-present and agent-initiated commerce for mid-market merchants. Its Agentic Checkout API requires the mandate chain and run record as a condition of processing, which is why it can produce construction context it does not itself generate.

Issues the consumer cards behind its own delegated-checkout product and sponsors the retail platforms that build on it. Unlike a pure acquirer it holds the cardholder relationship, so the consent record it can produce is its own SCA log rather than a merchant's attestation.

A retail bank offering assisted checkout to its own cardholders rather than acquiring for merchants. It sets the constraints its customers shop under — approved-seller lists above a value threshold, mandate lifetimes tied to the calendar day — so the failures it files are failures of its own controls, not a client's.
